intro.en: Mi Fu is Captain of the Wuling Watch, subordinate to Viceroy Tianshi Zhuang Fangyi, and successor of Qingbo Martial Arts, now on an exchange at Endfield Industries.
intro.zh-TW: 弭弗是武陵城巡衛隊隊長、管代天師莊方宜的部下與清波武藝傳人，目前正在終末地工業展開交流。

basic.en: Physical combo of up to 4 hits. As the controlled operator, her final strike also deals 25 Stagger.
basic.zh-TW: 最多 4 段的物理傷害連擊。作為主控幹員時，重擊額外造成 25 點失衡。

battle.en: Chains up to 3 moves. Cloudtrapper deals Physical damage, tries to pull the target and nearby enemies toward her, returns 50 SP and turns the next battle skill into Trail and Mangle. Its final punch applies Crush; if that consumes 3 or more Vulnerability stacks from one target, the next battle skill becomes World Splitter, area Physical damage counted as Crush DMG. Each follow-up costs 50 SP.
battle.zh-TW: 連續施放最多 3 段招式：斷雲造成物理傷害，嘗試將目標與附近敵人拉向弭弗並返還 50 技力，隨後暫時替換為追形。追形揮拳造成物理傷害並在最後施加猛擊；若此猛擊從單一目標消耗至少 3 層破防，則暫時替換為開天。開天朝前方範圍造成大量物理傷害，視為猛擊傷害而非戰技傷害。追形、開天各消耗 50 點技力。

combo.en: Trigger: an enemy has 3 or more Vulnerability stacks. Mi Fu lands an uppercut for Physical damage and applies temporary Physical Susceptibility, temporarily replacing her next battle skill with Trail and Mangle.
combo.zh-TW: 觸發條件：有敵人達到 3 層及以上破防。弭弗以上勾拳對前方敵人造成物理傷害並施加一定時間的物理脆弱，隨後戰技暫時替換為追形。

ultimate.en: After a brief charge, Mi Fu dashes forward to forcibly Lift a target and slam them down for Physical damage, temporarily replacing her next battle skill with Trail and Mangle.
ultimate.zh-TW: 短暫蓄力後向前衝刺，對身前目標強制施加擊飛並砸向地面造成物理傷害，隨後戰技暫時替換為追形。

talents.en: When World Splitter hits a target that has Physical Susceptibility or is Staggered, its damage multiplier rises to 1.1 times (1.2 times at Promotion II).
talents.zh-TW: 開天命中處於物理脆弱或失衡狀態的目標時，傷害倍率提升為 1.1 倍（精英化II 為 1.2 倍）。

talents.en: Casting her combo skill grants a shield equal to 15% of Max HP (30% at Promotion III) for 10 s, making Mi Fu harder to interrupt while it holds; triggers at most once every 60 s.
talents.zh-TW: 施放連攜技後獲得 15% 最大生命值的護盾（精英化III 為 30%），持續 10 秒，期間更難被打斷；每 60 秒最多觸發一次。

potentials.en: Fists of No Regrets has 2 s shorter cooldown, and its Physical Susceptibility gains +5% effect and +4 s duration.
potentials.zh-TW: 拳出無悔的冷卻縮短 2 秒，其物理脆弱效果提高 5% 且延長 4 秒。

potentials.en: Vigilant Fury's shield lasts 5 s longer with 15 s shorter trigger cooldown, and each trigger gives Mi Fu ATK +6% for 20 s.
potentials.zh-TW: 怒意留心的護盾持續時間 +5 秒、觸發間隔 -15 秒，每次觸發使弭弗攻擊力 +6%，持續 20 秒。

potentials.en: Pile of No Mercy costs 15% less Ultimate Energy.
potentials.zh-TW: 絕心所需的終結技能量 -15%。

potentials.en: Cloudtrapper, Trail and Mangle, and World Splitter deal 1.1 times their damage (stacking with Stern Crackdown), and Pile of No Mercy deals +5 Stagger.
potentials.zh-TW: 斷雲、追形與開天的傷害倍率提升為 1.1 倍（可與冷面無情疊加），且絕心造成的失衡值 +5 點。
